gait.source: Retain actual11999 gait1.0 using original bound source default0.5 override; no reward change relative to actual parent.

command_provenance: Exact saved12700 command ranges. Two of ten environment-index groups use the matched yaw audit vx and yaw magnitude. Both begin straight, then group 0 receives positive yaw and group 1 negative yaw. Original standing selection takes priority and the other groups retain the native sampler.
hypothesis: r41 walks and sustains the right turn; its remaining defect is ankle target motion after the zero-speed stop. Keep r41 sampling/rewards unchanged and add ONE zero-command ankle action-rate term (-0.10) to quiesce the stopped ankles without harming turn/route.
side_effects: A finite ankle action-rate cost under exactly zero command can resist corrective ankle reactions or delay stopping; it does not gate nonzero commands but shared PPO updates can still affect walking. Protect signed turn, route, pitch and no-fall.

std.source: Reconstruct the verified r41 parent runtime yaw std 0.3 from the original base default 0.5. The yaw tracking reward is unchanged relative to r41.

contact_lateral_tilt.source: Reconstruct exact saved12700 bilateral normal-force weighted moving cost from the original base.

zero_command_ankle_action_rate_l2.source: First-round candidate: on r41 zero-command replay frames the -0.10 ankle penalty is ~0.85x the whole-body action-rate at initial stand and 0.95-1.05x at late stop (offline recompute). Training-only reward on the 4 ankle raw-action increments under exactly zero command.
